selection: First 2000 valid unique PuzzleIds in official source-file order; rating 600..1800 inclusive, rating deviation <=100, popularity >=80, plays >=100; valid standard-chess FEN and legal Moves[0]. No theme or diagnosis selection.
blunder_column: Moves[0] only; continuation and game URLs not retained
prefix_note: A byte-range prefix ends mid-zstd-frame. Streaming stops after the fixed N, before the incomplete frame; the full compressed file is not required.
